# NJ Permit Practice

> Free, independent study material for the New Jersey MVC basic automobile knowledge test.

Canonical site: https://njknowledgetest.netlify.app/
Last comprehensive review: 2026-10-11
Current manual used: NJ MVC Driver Manual, revised 09/26

## What the site provides

- 334 original New Jersey-specific multiple-choice practice questions.
- A balanced 10-question diagnostic covering all ten major categories.
- A balanced 50-question mock exam with the official 40-correct passing target.
- Immediate explanations and links to sources after each answer.
- Category study and missed-question review stored locally in the visitor's browser.
- All study material is free and requires no account.

## Core NJ knowledge test facts

- The basic automobile knowledge test has 50 scored questions plus an organ-donation survey question.
- A passing result requires 40 correct answers, or 80 percent.
- A failed knowledge test may be retaken after seven days.
- The NJ MVC fee schedule lists the automobile examination permit at $10.
- The test requires an MVC permit and knowledge-test appointment; availability during a permit appointment varies.
- The secure live MVC question bank is not public. This site does not claim to reproduce leaked exam questions.
